task:
Rework the V3 home page (apps/web/src/routes/+page.svelte) to match the owner-approved concept direction, using only existing app data and APIs. Context and authority - Owner-approved direction: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-ui-concept-pack/ (README.md, HANDOFF.txt, journey-notes.txt). The home-page mockup itself (00-orbis-home.png) is deliberately NOT in the repository; work from the description below and from the plan section for the home page in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md. - Owner decisions for this change (2026-11-03): (1) the headline uses the condensed HUD font already in the design kit (`--font-hud`, Saira Semi Condensed), NOT a serif; (2) the hero background is the black hole screenshot now on main at apps/web/static/assets/home-hero-black-hole-1920.webp (desktop) and home-hero-black-hole-960.webp (phones). Do not add any other image. - apps/web only. Kit tokens only (colours, radii, fonts from the design kit); no new colour literals except inside a documented gradient scrim built from existing tokens. What the page should look like (desktop 1280 wide) 1. Hero fills the first screen under the existing WorkspaceHeader. Background is the black hole image, cover-fitted, with the black hole kept in the right-hand half. A dark left-to-right gradient scrim (built from --bg / --panel tokens) keeps all text on the left half at readable contrast (WCAG AA against the scrim, check in a test or document the computed ratio in CHANGES). The image is decorative: CSS background or an , never conveying information. Phones (<= 640px) use the 960 px file; larger widths use the 1920 px file. Do not preload both. The image must not shift layout (reserve the hero height in CSS). 2. Left column, top to bottom: - Eyebrow, orange, uppercase HUD font: "Your colony starts here" followed by a thin orange rule. - H1 in --font-hud, heavy weight, large: "Find your next frontier" with the final full stop in --accent orange. Keep exactly one h1. Remove the old "Search the galaxy. Find your future." heading, and update page.test.ts to assert the new heading. - Lede, two short lines: "Discover promising systems." / "Compare colony potential.
